name: Distributed 3DGS Training
definition: A distributed training approach that partitions datasets across HPC nodes to overcome single-GPU memory limits (approx. 11.2M Gaussians on A100), using ghost cells at boundaries for smooth transitions and background masks to eliminate artifacts.
summary: Distributed 3DGS Training partitions parameters across GPUs to enable large-scale scene training while preserving the original algorithm via spatial partitioning and ghost cells.
